Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I won't pass the Vantorre/Bluefin details to Ruth or post them anywhere. Mateo shared them with you privately, so they stay with you unless the people involved decide otherwise.

If Ruth needs to know before the news is official, the right route is for you or Mateo to brief her directly. I can help you prepare a note for her that doesn't include anything Mateo told you in confidence, or set up a time on her calendar if that helps.
